# Repository Audit

## Scope and method

State what was inspected, what was excluded, and how findings were verified.

## Findings and evidence

Preserve observations and evidence in narrative form. Link actionable findings to their task IDs.

## Recommendations

Extract distinct, actionable work into the canonical task table. Link to an existing owner rather than creating duplicate tasks.
